items.claim: Tools slot goes blank when the newest canvas unmounts while an earlier one is still mounted
A held tool's `[`/`]`/Shift+wheel step actions are enabled only for the active tool
items.note: (the step actions and the option tuning now share one `liveTool` rule)

items.claim: A mode's `defaultTool` can name an ambient tool, which makes `setActive` throw
A tool id or shared key with a dot never reads back from the prefs store
items.note: This was worse than reported: the prefs schema itself throws on a dotted key, so `toolOptionsPrefs` now nests a dotted id's group one level per dot, and `get` walks the same path. Option keys and shared keys with a dot now throw (strict call, recorded in `docs/unruled.md`).

items.claim: A tool id `shared` collides with the shared-options owner
items.note: `defineTool` and `toolOptionsPrefs` now throw for a tool with options named `shared` or `shared.*` (strict call, recorded in `docs/unruled.md`).
